title: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) Policy & Guidelines

nodes.title: 1. Programme Overview & Type
nodes.content:
Programme Name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
Jurisdiction: India
Category: Publicly funded health assurance
Type: Insurance / Health Assurance
Details: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover at empanelled hospitals. Standard cover is up to ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year, subject to applicable rules and package limits.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria & Conditions
nodes.content:
Eligibility: Eligibility for most beneficiaries is based on the applicable beneficiary database and scheme rules. Separately, Indian citizens aged 70+ are eligible under the senior-citizen expansion regardless of income; Aadhaar-based e-KYC is required for that enrolment.
Individual Enrolment Required: True

nodes.title: 3. Required Documents & Documentation
nodes.content: Required Documents: For 70+ enrolment: Aadhaar for e-KYC. For other beneficiaries, carry accepted identity and family/beneficiary details; exact requirements depend on the verification channel.

nodes.title: 4. Application Procedure & Access Desks
nodes.content:
Where to Apply / Access: Check eligibility and enrol through the official beneficiary portal or Ayushman App; alternatively visit a CSC or empanelled hospital/Ayushman Mitra.
Official Portal: https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/
